ocr.label: OCR level

hints.none: Only the digital text of PDFs: scanned pages and text inside images are skipped.
hints.fast: Local OCR of scans and of images inside PDFs. Quick, no AI cost; weaker on complex tables.
hints.structured: Local layout analysis: rebuilds tables and headings as markdown. Slower (seconds per page).
hints.vision: Every page is read by the AI vision model: best on photos, handwriting and difficult layouts. One AI call per page.
